title: Services Delivery Manager (Professional services Team)
description:
Why Join Us?
   

  

 Join Check Point Software Technologies as a Delivery Manager and be part of our global mission. As leaders in the Cyber Security industry, we tackle the most complex challenges head\-on. Our diverse team of passionate individuals is dedicated to innovation and excellence. We empower our clients with cutting\-edge solutions, serving a growing global customer base. By joining our team, you'll have the chance to make a meaningful impact in a remote\-friendly, fast\-paced, and fun environment.
   

  

 This role is responsible for leading operational delivery activities across the India Professional Services project delivery business, supporting consultants delivering enterprise security implementations, migrations, upgrades and customer escalations.
   

  

 The environment is highly dynamic and fast paced, requiring strong operational leadership, stakeholder management and delivery governance capabilities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Create and execute efficient personnel management plans
* Keep consultants utilization at a high level to meet annual objectives
* Improve the skills of our Professional Services consultants
* Maintain and increase the technical certification of consultants on the team
* Maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, sales and SE teams
* Strive to continuously improve current service offerings and delivery governance
* Help develop additional service offerings to enhance customer value
* Own and lead customer escalations end\-to\-end, working directly with customers, sales, SEs, TAC and consultants to drive resolution
* Lead operational cadence calls and ensure actions are tracked through to completion
* Always strive to improve the project delivery process and reporting structure
* Conduct regular 1:1 meetings with consultants
* Identify current and future challenges relating to skills, promotion, utilization and role development
* Demonstrate strong leadership presence by driving discussions, decisions and outcomes
* Be proactive, innovative and operationally focused
* Help with consultant recruitment and hiring
* Act as the primary delivery partner to sales leadership, ensuring regular communication, alignment and execution
* Support management of critical customer cutovers, weekend activities and enterprise delivery requirements
* Drive operational forecasting, resource planning and escalation management across the India project delivery business


**Qualifications**
* Experience managing a team of technical consultants or engineers
* Strong customer service, project management and quality control skills
* Proven experience managing escalations and enterprise customer situations
* Strong resource planning and operational management skills
* Excellent leadership and stakeholder management capabilities
* Strong teamwork skills and attention to detail
* Experience with Check Point technologies is preferred
* Experience managing firewall migrations, enterprise implementations or large\-scale delivery engagements is highly desirable
* Familiarity with technologies such as Maestro, VSX, VPN, CloudGuard and enterprise security environments is advantageous
* Ability to manage conflicts and make strong operational decisions under pressure
* Capacity to mentor and develop team members
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

title: Technical Delivery Manager - WebOps - Core Maintenance
description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, SWE, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience: 12y\+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance \& core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y\+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design \& Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Regex, database concepts.
* 5y\+ experience using GIT based continuous integration \& delivery
* Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
* Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc…)


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

title: Global Biometrics Delivery Lead
description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insight driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Global Biometrics Delivery Lead to join our team in a
 **Remote** 
 capacity. As a Global Biometrics Delivery Lead, you will have overall accountability for the execution of Data Operations strategy and Data Operations technology setup across clinical projects and programs. Acting as a central point of coordination, you will provide leadership across database programming, data integration, data management, and statistical services while working closely with clients, cross functional stakeholders, and Global Data Operations teams worldwide.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to influence the successful delivery of clinical trials by ensuring key milestones, timelines, quality standards, and operational objectives are achieved. You will drive collaboration across teams, manage project level budgets and resourcing, support risk mitigation activities, and provide leadership that enables efficient, high\-quality clinical data delivery.
   

  

 You will join a collaborative, fast paced environment where your contributions directly support the development of innovative therapies and strengthen Parexel's commitment to clinical research excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the execution of Data Operations strategy and Data Operations technology setup for assigned projects and programs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Global Data Operations activities, partnering with clients, functional leaders, and project stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
* Provide leadership across database programming, data integration, data management, and statistical services teams operating across multiple geographies.
* Create and execute project timeline plans covering all Global Data Operations deliverables and coordinate dependencies across Data Management, Programming, and Biostatistics functions.
* Manage project budgets, resource planning, and staffing requirements while monitoring productivity and project progress.
* Ensure project activities comply with quality standards, SOPs, ICH\-GCP requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Identify project risks proactively and contribute to risk mitigation planning and resolution activities.
* Support project startup, study conduct, closeout activities, audits, inspections, and project documentation maintenance.
* Collaborate with study teams and Data Standards Associates to support the use of applicable data standards.
* Establish effective working relationships with functional experts and provide leadership, guidance, and project direction to team members as appropriate.
* Monitor scope, timelines, deliverables, and project metrics to ensure contractual commitments and business objectives are achieved.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to operational excellence across project delivery activities.


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Strengths in project leadership, stakeholder engagement, and cross functional collaboration.
* Experience working within clinical research and clinical trial environments.
* The ability to influence, negotiate, and build productive relationships across global and virtual teams.
* A quality focused mindset with strong organizational and problem solving capabilities.
* Comfort working across multiple studies and managing competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in a science or industry related discipline, or equivalent qualification.
* Demonstrated application of project management concepts.
* Proven experience leading project teams in a technical, programming, data management, or statistical environment with minimal supervision.
* Understanding of cross functional clinical development activities.
* Knowledge of SOPs, ICH\-GCP guidelines, and applicable local and international regulations.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within global and culturally diverse teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10\+ Experience supporting data management, statistical programming, data integration, or biometrics functions within clinical development.
* Understanding of clinical trial systems and how technology platforms support Data Operations delivery.
* Experience participating in audits, inspections, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of clinical data standards and their application within clinical trials.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
